subject.en: Give your game team a head start on new 3D props
subject.zh: 下一版游戏，让团队从初版模型继续做

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can start props for the next game build from generated models instead of building every initial shape by hand.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, your artists can turn a text brief or reference image into a starting 3D model, then continue in their current workflow.
• **Tripo generates the starting model:** Artists get a model to work from for props on the project list.
• **Your team keeps creative control:** Artists refine the shape and materials, review the result and approve what meets the game's requirements.

**To help you evaluate the fit,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real project assets. Compare time, cost and quality with your current process, including the work after generation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏的道具，您的团队可以从生成模型开始做，不必每个初版造型都从零搭建。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，美术可以把文字需求或参考图变成初版 3D 模型，再按现有流程继续制作。
• **Tripo 生成初版模型：** 为项目清单上的道具提供制作起点。
• **您的团队掌握创作方向：** 美术调整造型和材质，审核结果，再批准符合游戏要求的资产。

**为了帮您判断是否适合，** 我们愿意一起规划用 10 个真实项目资产做试点。与现有流程比较工时、成本和质量，也把生成之后的工作算进去。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:
The goal is less initial modeling without creating more repair work later.

For 10 assets from your team's game project, we'd be happy to help plan a comparison against the current workflow. The same briefs and quality requirements should apply to both approaches.
• Track the time to a useful starting model, plus generation and retry fees, including unsuccessful attempts.
• Include artist cleanup, materials, review, tool compatibility and engine checks through final approval.

That comparison shows which assets need less total work and which are better made with the current process. Your team keeps the art direction and final approval.

Before starting, Tripo and your team need to agree the asset list, available evaluation support, who runs the checks and which records can be supplied. Scope, availability, access and fees also need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
目标是减少初版建模工作，而不是把省下来的工作变成后续返修。

这样能看清哪些资产的总投入更少，哪些仍适合按现有方式制作。美术方向和最终验收仍由您的团队掌握。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can reuse a suitable game prop without asking its creator to send the same starting model again.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, models generated in team mode go into the team library. Teammates can find shared assets under the workspace's visibility settings and continue work from a model that already exists.
• **Tripo keeps team models together:** The shared library gives your artists one place to find those assets.
• **Your team decides what to reuse:** Artists adapt the model, review the changes and approve it for the next game build.

**To help you evaluate the workflow,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets. Compare handoff time, repeated work, total cost and the quality of the reused results.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

合适的游戏道具，您的团队可以直接找到初版模型继续用，不必再次请原作者发送同一个文件。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，团队模式生成的模型会进入团队资产库。成员按工作区的可见设置查找共享资产，从已有模型继续制作。
• **Tripo 集中保存团队模型：** 共享资产库为美术提供统一的查找位置。
• **您的团队决定如何复用：** 美术调整模型、审核修改，再批准用于下一版游戏。

**为了帮您评估这套流程，** 我们愿意一起规划用 10 个真实资产做试点。比较交接工时、重复工作、总成本，以及复用结果的质量。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:
The useful saving is work your team no longer has to repeat, not simply a file opened by a second person.

For 10 real game assets, we'd be happy to help plan a comparison of shared-library use with your current handoffs.
• Record whether another artist can find and reuse a suitable model, plus file requests, repeated modeling and access-management time.
• Include the changes, review and engine checks required for the reused asset, alongside original generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts and cleanup.

That gives you time, cost and quality to compare at the point of approval. Reuse does not automatically mean the asset needs less work.

Team Plan provides the library. Your team's existing workflow defines how externally refined files return and how approved versions are identified. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the assets, available support and records, responsibilities, access, availability and fees.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
真正值得比较的是团队少重复了哪些工作，而不只是同一个文件被第二个人打开。

我们愿意一起规划，用 10 个真实游戏资产，对比共享资产库与当前交接方式。
• 记录其他美术能否找到并复用合适模型，以及索要文件、重复建模和管理权限花费的时间。
• 计入复用资产所需的修改、审核和引擎检查，也包括原始生成和重试费用、失败尝试及清理工作。

这样可以比较验收时的工时、成本和质量。复用并不自动代表制作工作更少。

Team Plan 提供资产库。外部精修文件如何回到共享流程、怎样识别已批准的版本，仍按团队现有流程安排。开始前，需与 Tripo 确认资产、可提供的支持和记录、分工、使用权限、是否可安排及费用。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can work on AI-generated assets for the next game build without sharing a login or leaving member access unclear.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives each teammate their own access and lets administrators manage roles and asset visibility in one workspace.
• **Tripo provides the access controls:** Administrators can invite members, adjust roles, remove access and set what members can see.
• **Your team owns the review decisions:** The people responsible for checking and approving game assets remain part of your existing workflow.

**To help you evaluate those controls,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real game assets. Compare administration time and total cost while checking that the assets meet your team's quality standards.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏采用 AI 生成资产时，您的团队可以各用自己的账号，不必共用登录信息，也能把成员访问权限管理清楚。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 为成员提供各自的访问权限，让管理员在同一个工作区管理角色和资产可见范围。
• **Tripo 提供访问控制：** 管理员可以邀请成员、调整角色、移除访问权限，并设置成员能看到哪些资产。
• **您的团队决定如何审核：** 谁检查、谁批准游戏资产，仍按团队现有流程安排。

**为了帮您评估这些控制，** 我们愿意一起规划用 10 个真实游戏资产做试点。比较管理工时和总成本，同时检查资产是否达到团队的质量标准。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:
Access controls help your team manage who can work with generated assets. Approval still belongs to your production process.

For a 10-asset pilot, we'd be happy to help plan checks of invitations, role changes, member removal and asset visibility against your team's working arrangements. Administrators retain visibility across the workspace; member usage data is not a complete generation or approval history.

Your team sets its own input-rights, review, disclosure and final-use requirements. Before starting, agree with Tripo which records and support are available, who keeps them and who performs each check.

The comparison should include administration and review time, generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, artist refinement and engine checks. This puts access-management costs alongside the quality of the approved assets, without treating the pilot as a compliance certificate.

Scope, availability, access, responsibilities and fees need confirmation. Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

您的团队可以为资产工具加入 3D 生成功能，不必同时另起一个底层 AI 模型研发项目。

接入 Tripo API 后，开发团队可以让用户在自己的工具中，用文字或图片生成模型。
• **我们负责生成：** Tripo 运行生成服务，提供任务状态和完成后的模型文件。
• **您保留决定权：** 开发团队设计用户体验、维护集成；资产如何精修、审核和批准，由您的团队决定。

**为了帮助您评估这项投入，**可以用 10 个资产，对比现有工作流的工程时间、持续成本和输出质量，也计入让每个资产达到可用要求所需的工作。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

followup.en:
Your product needs a working generation feature, not another model-development roadmap.

The 10-asset test can follow the feature inside your own tool: users submit a request, see its status and receive a model they can refine. Tripo supplies the generation service. Your developers connect the interface, handle authentication and failed requests, and maintain the integration.

The comparison would cover initial engineering time and ongoing maintenance, as well as generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, artist refinement, review and file checks. Your team can assess the time and cost per accepted asset alongside the quality users need.

Your team defines the acceptance checklist. Before testing, Tripo and your team would agree on the scope, who runs each evaluation, available technical support and records, access and fees. Your team keeps control of the product experience and final approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
您的产品需要的是能够运行的生成功能，而不是再增加一条模型研发计划。

10 个资产的测试可以覆盖自己工具中的完整功能：用户提交请求、查看状态、收到可继续精修的模型。Tripo 提供生成服务；开发团队负责界面衔接、认证、失败请求处理和集成维护。

比较包含初始工程时间、持续维护、生成与重试费用、失败尝试、美术精修、审核和文件检查。您可以结合用户需要的质量，判断每个通过验收的资产需要多少时间和成本。

验收清单由您的团队定义。测试前，双方需确认范围、谁执行各项评测、可提供的技术支持和记录、使用权限及费用。产品体验与最终批准仍由您的团队掌握。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can use generated models without handing over the decisions that make an asset fit your production standards.

By integrating Tripo API, your developers can bring generated files into your own tool, ready for the next steps in your current workflow.
• **We handle generation:** Tripo turns text or reference images into initial 3D models that your tool can retrieve.
• **You keep control:** Your artists refine geometry and materials, review the files in their usual software and approve assets against your requirements.

**To help you evaluate that fit**, a test with 10 real assets can compare time, total cost and quality through final review, using the same standards as your current workflow.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队可以使用生成模型，同时继续按自己的制作标准决定资产该怎么完成。

接入 Tripo API 后，开发团队可以把生成文件带进自己的工具，继续现有工作流中的后续制作。
• **我们负责生成：** Tripo 根据文字或参考图生成初版 3D 模型，供您的工具取回。
• **您保留决定权：** 美术在常用软件里精修几何与材质、审核文件，再按项目要求批准资产。

**为了帮助您评估适配情况，**可以用 10 个真实资产，按现有工作流的同一套标准，比较到最终审核为止的耗时、总成本和质量。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

followup.en:
The model needs to work in your production tools, not just look convincing in a preview.

For a 10-asset comparison, your team sets the geometry, topology, polygon count, UV, material, scale and file requirements that matter to the project. Your artists refine the generated models and review them in the intended software. Rigging checks belong in the test only where an asset needs them.

The comparison covers quality and the full time and cost to approval: generation, retries, failed attempts, cleanup, review, file checks, integration and maintenance. Results that need too much repair remain part of the comparison.

Your team owns the acceptance checklist and final approval. Before starting, Tripo and your team would confirm the checks each side performs, available evaluation support and records, scope, access and fees.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
模型需要能在您的制作工具中使用，而不只是预览图看起来像成品。

对比 10 个资产时，您的团队先确定项目需要的几何、拓扑、面数、UV、材质、尺寸和文件要求。美术精修生成模型，再放进目标软件审核；只有资产确实需要时，才加入绑定检查。

比较包含质量，以及直到批准为止的完整时间和成本：生成、重试、失败尝试、清理、审核、文件检查、接入与维护。需要大量修复的结果也保留在对比中。

验收清单和最终批准由您的团队掌握。开始前，双方需确认各自执行哪些检查、可提供的评测支持和记录，以及范围、使用权限和费用。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can give reviewers a clear record of where a generated asset came from and who approved it in your own tool.

By integrating Tripo API, your developers can connect each generation task to the asset records your team already maintains.
• **We handle generation:** Tripo generates the model and provides its task ID, status and output links.
• **You keep control:** Your system stores the original request and inputs; your team records later edits, reviews and approvals.

**To help you evaluate the record flow**, a test with 10 real assets can compare time, cost and quality with your current workflow, while checking that reviewers can find the request and approval behind each file.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队可以在自己的工具里，让审核人查到生成资产的来源，以及由谁批准使用。

接入 Tripo API 后，开发团队可以把每次生成任务关联到团队已有的资产记录。
• **我们负责生成：** Tripo 生成模型，并提供对应的任务 ID、状态和结果链接。
• **您保留决定权：** 原始请求与输入由自己的系统保存，后续修改、审核和批准由团队记录。

**为了帮助您评估记录衔接，**可以用 10 个真实资产，对比现有工作流的时间、成本和质量，同时检查审核人能否找到每份文件对应的请求与批准记录。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

followup.en:
A reviewer needs more than a finished model: the original request, the changes made to it and the decision to approve it.

For 10 real assets, your developers can connect Tripo task IDs and results to records in your own tool. Your system stores the original requests and inputs, downloads the returned files, and links later edits, reviews and approvals. The API provides task information, not a complete audit trail.

The test can compare record-retrieval time and output quality alongside total costs: integration, record maintenance, generation, retries, failed attempts, refinement and review. Your team decides the input permissions, retention, disclosure and final-use requirements.

Before starting, Tripo and your team would confirm available task data, who runs the checks, evaluation support, records, scope, access and fees. Your team keeps final approval; task data does not establish asset rights or compliance.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
审核人需要的不只是最终模型，还包括原始请求、做过哪些修改，以及为什么批准使用。

针对 10 个真实资产，开发团队可以把 Tripo 的任务 ID 和结果关联到自己工具中的记录。自己的系统保存原始请求与输入、下载返回文件，并关联后续修改、审核和批准。API 提供的是任务信息，不是完整审计记录。

测试可以比较查找记录的时间、输出质量和完整成本：接入、记录维护、生成、重试、失败尝试、精修与审核。输入素材权限、保存期限、披露和最终用途要求由您的团队确定。

开始前，双方需确认可取得的任务数据、谁执行检查、评测支持、记录、范围、使用权限和费用。最终批准由您的团队决定；任务信息不证明资产权利或合规。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can start the next level's crates, furniture and chests with models to refine, rather than an empty modeling scene.

By using Tripo Studio Team Plan, your artists can generate an initial 3D model from the level's reference images or a written brief.
• **Tripo creates the starting shape:** Your artists get a model to develop for each selected prop.
• **Your artists shape it for the scene:** They refine the geometry and materials in their current workflow, then review and approve the result.

**To help you evaluate the work involved,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets from that level. Compare time, cost and quality all the way to approved props, not just the first generated result.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一关的木箱、家具和宝箱，您的团队可以先拿到模型再精修，不必都从空白建模场景开始。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，美术可以根据关卡参考图或文字需求，生成初版 3D 模型。
• **Tripo 生成初版造型：** 为选定的道具提供模型，供团队继续制作。
• **您的美术按场景精修：** 按现有流程调整几何和材质，再审核并批准结果。

**为了帮您评估完整投入，** 我们愿意一起规划，从这一关选 10 个真实资产做试点。一直比较到道具通过验收时的工时、成本和质量，不只看第一次生成的结果。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:
The level's asset list keeps the comparison grounded in work your artists actually need to deliver.

We'd be happy to help plan a pilot around 10 of those assets, using the same scene requirements as your current production process.
• Compare the time to a useful starting model, generation and retry fees, including unsuccessful attempts.
• Add the geometry and material work, review, tool compatibility and engine checks needed to approve each prop.

The result should separate useful starting models from props that take more work to repair than to build another way. Your team keeps the scene's art direction and acceptance criteria.

Before starting, your team and Tripo need to agree the asset list, available evaluation support and records, and who carries out each check. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation too.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
关卡的资产清单，让对比落在美术真正需要交付的工作上。

我们愿意一起规划，用其中 10 个资产做试点，沿用现有制作流程的场景要求。
• 比较得到可用初版的时间，以及生成和重试费用，包括失败尝试的实际成本。
• 加上道具通过验收所需的几何与材质制作、审核、工具适配和引擎检查。

结果应当分清哪些初版确实有用，哪些修起来比换一种方式制作更费工。场景美术方向和验收标准仍由您的团队掌握。

开始前，您的团队与 Tripo 需确认资产清单、可提供的评测支持和记录，以及每项检查的执行分工。范围、是否可安排、使用权限和费用也需确认。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

intro.zh:

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can use a suitable generated prop as the starting point for another scene, instead of making the same initial shape twice.

Tripo Studio Team Plan puts models generated in team mode into a shared library. A second artist can find the model under the workspace's visibility settings and assess it for the new scene.
• **Tripo makes team models available:** Shared assets stay together in the library for teammates to find.
• **Your artists adapt and approve:** They change the model for the scene, review it and decide whether it is ready to use.

**To help you evaluate reuse,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real game assets. Compare handoff time, revision costs and final quality with your current workflow.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队可以把合适的生成道具用作另一个场景的制作起点，不必把同一个初版造型做两遍。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 会把团队模式生成的模型放进共享资产库。另一位美术可以按工作区的可见设置找到模型，判断它是否适合新场景。
• **Tripo 集中保存共享模型：** 共享资产集中保存在资产库里，供成员找到并使用。
• **您的美术调整和验收：** 按新场景修改模型、审核结果，再决定是否可以采用。

**为了帮您评估复用，** 我们愿意一起规划用 10 个真实游戏资产做试点，与现有流程比较交接工时、修改成本和最终质量。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:
A shared crate may work as a starting point in two scenes, but the second scene can still need different geometry or materials.

We'd be happy to help plan a 10-asset pilot that follows those changes from one artist to the next.
• Compare finding and reusing a shared model with requesting files or modeling the same shape again.
• Record adjustments, review and engine checks, alongside the original generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts and cleanup.

Include the time needed to manage access and organize the handoff. Compare total cost and final quality, not just the number of reused files.

Team Plan supplies the shared library. Your existing workflow still defines how externally refined files return and how approved versions are identified. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the assets, evaluation support, records, responsibilities, availability, access and fees.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can update who sees generated assets when artists join or leave work on the next game build.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, administrators can manage member access in the workspace instead of continuing to share one login.
• **Tripo provides member controls:** Invite artists, change roles, remove access and set asset visibility as the working team changes.
• **Your team assigns review responsibility:** Keep decisions about who checks a prop and who approves it in your own production workflow.

This gives each artist their own access while keeping the administrator responsible for workspace settings.

**To help you evaluate the setup,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real game assets. Compare administration time, total cost and the quality of assets approved under your current process.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏的制作成员加入或离开时，您的团队可以相应调整谁能看到生成资产。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，管理员可以在工作区管理成员访问权限，不必继续共用一个登录账号。
• **Tripo 提供成员控制：** 随制作人员变化邀请美术、调整角色、移除访问权限，并设置资产可见范围。
• **您的团队安排审核分工：** 谁检查道具、谁批准使用，仍按自己的制作流程决定。

每位美术都有各自的访问权限，工作区设置则由管理员负责。

**为了帮您评估这套安排，** 我们愿意一起规划用 10 个真实游戏资产做试点。比较管理工时、总成本，以及按现有流程验收的资产质量。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

followup.en:

We'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 real assets to check invitations, role changes, removal of access and asset visibility. Administrators retain full workspace visibility. Member usage information can support management, but it is not a complete generation or approval record.

Your production process still determines input rights, reviewers, final approval and any disclosure. Before starting, Tripo and your team need to agree which records and evaluation support are available, who retains records and who performs each check.

Compare administration and review time, generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, refinement and engine checks against your current workflow. That shows the cost of managing access alongside final asset quality; it does not certify compliance.

Scope, availability, access, responsibilities and fees need confirmation. Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your artists can start the crates, lamps and furniture for a new level from generated models. They can work on the shapes the scene needs instead of constructing every starting mesh by hand.

By integrating Tripo API into your studio's asset tool, developers can turn the level's text briefs or reference images into model files for the art team to refine.

• **We handle the first model:** Tripo generates the 3D file and provides it through the API.
• **You keep control:** Your team maintains the tool integration, adjusts each prop for the scene and approves the finished work.

**To help you evaluate that approach, let's plan a 10-asset API test using props from the level.** Compare time, cost and final asset quality with the current process.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

新关卡需要的箱子、灯具和家具，您的美术团队可以从生成模型开始做，把工作放在调整场景需要的造型上，不必每个初版都从零搭建。

开发团队将 Tripo API 接入工作室的资产工具后，可以把关卡的文字需求或参考图变成模型文件，交给美术精修。

• **我们负责初版生成：** Tripo 生成 3D 文件，并通过 API 提供结果。
• **您保留决定权：** 团队维护工具集成，按场景调整道具，并批准最终成果。

**想评估这种做法，可以用关卡里的 10 个资产安排 API 测试。** 与现有流程比较工时、费用和验收质量。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
For a playable level, the comparison needs to show how much work a prop takes from the first model to approval.

The test uses 10 real prop briefs from the level. Your team keeps the same requirements for shape, style, topology, materials and file format, with rigging checks where needed. Artists refine the retrieved files and check them in the game's engine.

Compare the first usable model, revisions, review and final asset quality with the current production process. Include generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, integration and ongoing maintenance. A quicker first result only helps if the remaining work makes sense for the level.

Your team and Tripo agree the asset list, evaluation support, who checks each result and who records it. Scope, availability, access and fees are confirmed before testing. Your team decides which props enter production.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
针对一个可玩关卡，要比较的是道具从初版模型到验收通过，总共需要多少工作。

测试以 10 个实际关卡道具的需求为依据。造型、风格、拓扑、材质和格式沿用团队原有要求，需要绑定的再检查绑定。美术精修取回的文件，并放进游戏引擎检查。

把首个可用模型、修改、审核和验收质量，与现有制作方式比较。生成及重试费用、失败尝试、接入和持续维护都计入成本。初版更快，只有在后续工作也适合这个关卡时才有意义。

您的团队与 Tripo 确认资产清单、评测支持、每项检查及记录分工。测试前确定范围、是否可安排、使用权限和费用。哪些道具进入制作，由您的团队决定。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your next game-tool release can let artists request new props from the interface they already use. Your developers can build that feature around an existing generation service instead of creating their own AI model.

By integrating Tripo API, the tool can send an artist's text brief or reference image, show task status and retrieve the resulting model for review and refinement.

• **We handle the generation service:** Tripo processes the request and returns task information and output files.
• **You keep control:** Your developers design the interface, handle errors and retries, and maintain the integration; your artists refine, review and approve the assets.

**To help you evaluate the release work, let's plan a 10-asset API test.** Compare the integration effort, operating cost and quality of usable results.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一次游戏工具发布，可以让美术在熟悉的界面里发起新道具生成。开发团队可以围绕现有生成服务做这项功能，不必自己开发 AI 模型。

接入 Tripo API 后，工具可以提交美术的文字需求或参考图，显示任务状态，并取回模型供审核和精修。

• **我们提供生成服务：** Tripo 处理请求，返回任务信息和输出文件。
• **您保留决定权：** 开发团队设计界面、处理异常与重试并维护集成；美术负责精修、审核和批准资产。

**想看清发布前的开发工作，可以先安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。** 对比接入投入、运行成本和可用结果的质量。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
A release test follows the feature an artist will actually use: enter a brief, wait for generation, retrieve the model and send it through production checks.

Across 10 real game assets, your developers assess request handling, asynchronous updates, failures, retries and file retrieval. Tripo provides the generation service; your team builds and maintains the working feature in your own tool.

Include integration and ongoing maintenance, generation and retry charges, failed attempts, artist cleanup, review and engine testing in the comparison. Measure how long an approved asset takes as well as whether the interface works. Your team defines quality requirements and decides if the feature is ready for release.

Before testing, agree with Tripo on the asset briefs, technical and evaluation support, checking and record-keeping responsibilities, scope, availability, access and fees. The test is an evaluation of the feature, not a promise of a finished integration.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
发布测试应当跟着美术真正会用的功能来做：输入需求、等待生成、取回模型，再进入制作检查。

用 10 个真实游戏资产，开发团队评估请求处理、异步更新、失败、重试和文件取回。Tripo 提供生成服务，您的团队开发并维护自己工具中的完整功能。

比较时计入接入和持续维护、生成及重试费用、失败尝试、美术清理、审核和引擎测试。除了界面是否可用，还要记录资产做到验收通过需要多久。团队制定质量要求，并决定功能是否可以发布。

测试前，与 Tripo 确认资产需求、技术和评测支持、检查与记录分工、范围、是否可安排、使用权限和费用。这是功能评估，不是承诺直接交付完成的集成。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Your team can keep an approved asset connected to its earlier versions, so reviewers can see what changed before it entered your library.

By integrating Tripo API, your developers can use task information to connect generation with revision records in your own tool.
• **We handle generation:** Tripo generates the model and provides its task ID, status and output links.
• **You keep control:** Your system saves the original requests and inputs, while your team records how artists refine, review and approve each version.

**To help you evaluate that handover**, a test with 10 real assets can compare time, cost and quality with your current workflow, and check that the final file leads back to its request and approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队可以把批准后的资产与此前版本关联起来，让审核人查到它进入资源库之前改过什么。

接入 Tripo API 后，开发团队可以利用任务信息，把生成环节关联到自己工具中的修改记录。
• **我们负责生成：** Tripo 生成模型，并提供对应的任务 ID、状态和结果链接。
• **您保留决定权：** 原始请求与输入由自己的系统保存；各版本如何精修、审核和批准，由团队记录。

**为了帮助您评估这次交接，**可以用 10 个真实资产，对比现有工作流的时间、成本和质量，并检查能否从最终文件找到对应的请求与批准。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

followup.en:
Once an artist has refined a model, the final file needs to stay connected to the request and the review that approved it.

A 10-asset test can follow those connections inside your own tool. Your developers save the original request and inputs, collect the API task ID and results, then link working versions, review notes and approvals. Tripo supplies generation task information; your system builds and keeps the wider record.

The comparison includes the time to find a version's history, asset quality and total cost: integration, record maintenance, generation, retries, unsuccessful attempts, refinement and review. Your team sets input permissions, retention, disclosure and final-use requirements.

Before testing, both teams would confirm available information, who checks each record, evaluation support, scope, access and fees. Your team approves the asset; API task data is neither a complete audit trail nor proof of rights or compliance.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
美术精修之后，最终文件仍需关联到原始请求，以及批准它的那次审核。

10 个资产的测试可以在自己的工具里核对这些关联。开发团队保存原始请求和输入，收集 API 任务 ID 与结果，再关联工作版本、审核意见和批准记录。Tripo 提供生成任务信息，更完整的记录由自己的系统建立并保存。

比较包含查找版本历史的时间、资产质量和总成本：接入、记录维护、生成、重试、失败尝试、精修与审核。输入素材权限、保存期限、披露和最终用途要求由您的团队确定。

测试前，双方需确认可取得的信息、谁检查各项记录、评测支持、范围、使用权限和费用。资产由您的团队批准；API 任务信息既不是完整审计记录，也不证明权利或合规。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。
